brief:
Gary, Indiana remained without electricity following an outage, Drop Site News reported. The utility company had not disclosed the cause of the blackage or provided a timeline for restoration at the time of the report.

The U.S. is preparing to unveil what officials have termed "economic D-day" sanctions against Iran, according to the outlet. The designation suggests a coordinated and comprehensive campaign targeting the Iranian economy.

Israeli forces struck a mosque and a desalination plant in Gaza during recent operations, Drop Site News reported. The strikes marked continued military action in the territory amid the broader conflict.
title: Gary loses power as U.S. prepares Iran sanctions, Israel strikes Gaza
